titleEn: Poly-B Pipe Replacement in Vancouver & Metro Vancouver: 2026 Costs, Risks & What Homeowners Need to Know
titleZh: 温哥华及大温地区聚丁烯（Poly-B）管道更换完整指南（2026年版）
contentEn:
Vancouver-area homeowners with homes built between 1986 and 1997 face a hidden threat: Poly-B piping. Grey in colour with dull fitting connections, polybutylene (Poly-B) was installed in an estimated 60,000 Metro Vancouver homes before being discontinued due to failure rates linked to chlorine reactions in municipal water supplies. If your Richmond, Surrey, or Coquitlam home still has Poly-B pipes, you are sitting on an insurance and liability risk that worsens every year.

How to Know If Your Home Has Poly-B Pipes

Poly-B pipes are typically grey plastic tubing 12 to 25 mm in diameter with dull white or grey fittings using crimp or insert connections. They most commonly run through basements, crawlspaces, and inside walls. Copper manifold systems replaced Poly-B in new construction after 1997. Marked piping near your water heater, under sinks, or running along basement ceiling joists are the most visible indicators. A plumber can confirm within 30 minutes whether your home is affected.

What Happens When Poly-B Fails

Poly-B fails in two ways: micro-fractures that cause slow leaks invisible to the eye, and sudden burst failures that can release thousands of litres of water inside a home in hours. Insurance companies in BC have classified Poly-B as a high-risk condition since the early 2000s. Many BC home insurers now refuse to issue new policies on homes with documented Poly-B plumbing, and those that do charge significantly higher premiums. A single water-loss claim from a Poly-B burst can exceed $75,000 in structural remediation, making proactive replacement the cheaper option.

2026 Poly-B Replacement Cost in Vancouver and Metro Vancouver

Re-plumbing an average Vancouver single-family home with copper or cross-linked polyethylene (PEX) now costs between $8,500 and $19,000 fully installed, depending on home size and accessibility. PEX is generally preferred for its freeze resistance and faster installation, reducing labour costs by 15 to 25 percent compared with rigid copper. Reno Stars completes most Metro Vancouver Poly-B replacements in 4 to 8 working days, with full municipal permit and inspection coordination included.

Does the City of Vancouver or BC Government Cover Any Poly-B Costs?

Neither the City of Vancouver nor the BC provincial government currently operates a dedicated Poly-B replacement subsidy program. However, two indirect pathways can reduce your out-of-pocket cost. First, FortisBC offers a water-pipe upgrade rebate of up to $500 when you replace lead or corroded service lines as part of a larger plumbing project. Second, CleanBC offers income-tested rebates of up to $10,000 for home energy retrofits that include plumbing work, subject to pre-approval and a post-work energy assessment.

Finding a Licensed Plumber for Poly-B Replacement in Metro Vancouver

In British Columbia, all plumbing work in residential buildings requires a licensed plumber with a BC Journeyman or Residential Builder registration. Reno Stars employs Red-Seal-certified plumbers experienced specifically in occupied-home Poly-B replacement, including water-service continuity planning to keep households connected during the 4-to-8-day project window. Ask any contractor for their BC builder registration number and confirm it on the Consumer Protection BC website before signing a contract.

Planning a renovation that involves opening walls or floors? A Poly-B assessment done concurrently with your Reno Stars renovation consultation lets you combine the plumbing work into a single project permit, reducing total cost and scheduling overlap.

Planning a kitchen, bathroom, whole-home or commercial renovation? Get a free, no-obligation quote from Reno Stars.

Frequently Asked Questions

Does home insurance cover Poly-B water damage?

Most BC insurers will not issue a new policy on a home with documented Poly-B piping, and existing policies may exclude Poly-B-related claims. Replacing the pipes eliminates this coverage gap and typically restores standard home-insurance eligibility immediately upon completion.

How long does a full Poly-B replacement take?

A single-family home typically requires 4 to 8 working days for complete re-piping, including pressure testing and municipal inspection sign-off. Reno Stars coordinates the city permit and inspection schedule directly with the City of Vancouver or your local municipal building department.

Can I stay in my home during the work?

Yes, in most cases. Reno Stars maintains water service to the kitchen and one bathroom throughout the project. The water supply to other fixtures may be temporarily interrupted during each day of pipe-installation work.

Is PEX piping as durable as copper?

Cross-linked polyethylene (PEX) carries a 25-year manufacturer warranty and has been used in residential plumbing in Canada since the early 2000s. It is freeze-resistant up to minus 20 degrees Celsius, making it well-suited to Vancouver weather conditions, and is now the standard for new residential construction in BC.

Should I replace Poly-B before selling my Vancouver home?

Yes, proactively. A pre-listing Poly-B replacement eliminates a material-disclosure risk that most buyers and their agents now specifically investigate. Reno Stars provides documentation for real-estate transactions including permit numbers, plumber certifications, and inspection sign-off certificates.
contentZh:
温哥华地区的业主们，如果您的房屋建于1986年至1997年之间，可能正面临一种隐蔽的威胁：聚丁烯（Poly-B）管道。这种灰色塑料管材配有暗淡的配件连接，据估计有约60,000套大温哥华地区的住宅使用了这种管材，后因与市政供水中氯反应导致的故障率而被停用。如果您的列治文、萨里或高贵林住宅至今仍使用Poly-B管道，您实际上承担着每年都在恶化的保险与责任风险。

如何判断您的房屋是否使用Poly-B管道

Poly-B管道通常是灰色塑料管，直径12至25毫米，采用压接或插入式连接的暗淡白色或灰色配件。这种管道最常见于地下室、爬行空间和墙壁内部。1997年后，新建住宅改用铜歧管系统。水暖加热器附近、厨房水槽下方或沿着地下室天花板托梁延伸的标记管道是最明显的识别标志。水管工可以在30分钟内确认您的房屋是否受到影响。

Poly-B管道出现故障时会发生什么

Poly-B管道以两种方式失效：导致肉眼不可见的缓慢渗漏的微裂缝，以及可能数小时内在家中释放数千升水的突然爆裂。自2000年代初以来，BC省保险公司已将Poly-B列为高风险状况。许多BC省房屋保险公司现在拒绝为有Poly-B管道记录的房屋承保新的保险，而提供承保的公司则收取显著更高的保费。一次Poly-B爆裂导致的水损索赔，结构修复费用可能超过75,000加元，使预防性更换成为更经济的选择。

2026年温哥华及大温地区Poly-B更换费用

使用铜或交联聚乙烯（PEX）为温哥华独立式住宅重新铺管，目前全包安装费用在8,500至19,000加元之间，具体取决于房屋面积和可达性。

房屋类型工程范围2026年估算费用
两浴室独立屋全屋重铺，铜管12,000至18,000加元
两浴室独立屋全屋重铺，PEX管9,500至14,500加元
联排别墅全屋重铺5,500至9,500加元
公寓单元仅更换供水管线2,500至5,500加元

Reno Stars通常在4至8个工作日内完成大多数大温Poly-B更换工程，包含完整的市政许可和检验协调。

大温地区在哪里可以找到许可水管工进行Poly-B更换

在不列颠哥伦比亚省，住宅建筑的所有水管工程必须由持有BC省Journeyman或住宅建筑商执照的许可水管工进行。Reno Stars雇佣持有红印证书的水管工，专门为已入住房屋进行Poly-B更换，包括水管连续性规划，确保住户在整个4至8天项目期间保持供水。 与Reno Stars装修咨询同时进行Poly-B评估，让您可以将管道工程合并为一个项目许可，减少总成本和日程重叠。

规划厨房、浴室、全屋或商业装修？获取Reno Stars的免费、无义务报价。

常见问题

房屋保险是否覆盖Poly-B水损？

大多数BC省保险公司不会为有Poly-B管道记录的房屋提供新保单，现有保单也可能排除Poly-B相关索赔。更换管道可消除这一保险覆盖缺口，并在完成后立即恢复标准房屋保险资格。

完整的Poly-B更换需要多长时间？

独立式住宅通常需要4至8个工作日完成全部重新铺管，包括压力测试和市政检验验收。Reno Stars直接与温哥华市或您当地市政建筑部门协调城市许可和检验日程。

施工期间我可以留在家中吗？

大多数情况下可以。Reno Stars在整个项目期间保持厨房和一个浴室的供水。在每天的管道安装工作期间，其他设备的供水可能会暂时中断。
